## 高频同义替换

### 动词类
- cause → lead to / result in / contribute to / give rise to
- change → alter / modify / transform / shift
- increase → rise / grow / soar / surge / climb
- decrease → fall / drop / decline / reduce / shrink
- improve → enhance / boost / strengthen / upgrade
- prevent → stop / hinder / inhibit / discourage
- need → require / demand / call for / necessitate

### 名词类
- problem → issue / challenge / difficulty / drawback
- advantage → benefit / merit / positive aspect / strength
- disadvantage → drawback / downside / weakness / limitation
- part → component / element / aspect / factor
- result → outcome / consequence / effect / impact

### 形容词类
- important → crucial / vital / essential / significant / key
- common → widespread / prevalent / universal / common
- different → various / diverse / distinct / varied
- many → numerous / a wide range of / a variety of
- new → novel / recent / modern / contemporary
